_producer: Person 1 / Person 2 (evidence_service.py after fuzzy matching + validation)
_consumer: Person 3 (renders field cards + evidence highlight), Person 4 (links into rule inputs and audit payloads)
_description: An extraction_candidate that has been matched back to real OCR text (exact match, or RapidFuzz score >= 0.90) and passed deterministic validation. If it cannot be matched, status is UNTRUSTED and it must never reach the rules engine.
